campaign.name: Transilience SOS — GDPR — Billtrust (Ankit Taneja)
campaign.service_line: Transilience SOS — LLM-OS for cloud security: LLM is the kernel, cloud is filesystem, security tools and compliance frameworks are peripherals; security operation runs as processes on the kernel. Holds full posture state as working memory. Executes continuously on its own clock. Surfaces only when human judgment, approval, or non-inferable context is required.
value_prop_anchors: GDPR is a peripheral the kernel evaluates continuously against current cloud state — not a deliverable produced for an audit window
Article 32 (security of processing) becomes a property of how the platform runs, not an artifact assembled at review time
Article 33 (72-hour notification) evidence is pre-staged in working memory; the SOC-to-DPO handoff is structured rather than reconstructed
Article 30 (RoPA) generated as a side-effect of continuous evaluation; data flows are observed, not declared
campaign.desired_cta: Fifteen minutes to compare notes if the framing fits
avoid_topics: claims that imply Billtrust's current SOC is broken
Belgium e-invoicing recency without operational connection (caught in v1 review of yesterday's run)
fragile geographic shorthand (Ghent, Brussels) — caught in yesterday's post-ship review

sender.name: Transilience
sender.title: Founder/Outreach
sender.company_one_liner: Transilience builds SOS, an LLM-OS for cloud security — the LLM is the kernel, the cloud is its filesystem, security tools and compliance frameworks are peripherals, and the security operation runs as processes on top.
sender.voice_notes: Dry, peer-to-peer, allergic to vendor adjectives. Credibility comes from operational specificity (citing articles by number, naming the seam, holding controller/processor distinctions cleanly). Never claim what hasn't been earned. Earn the GDPR claim operationally, not legally.
credible_claims: Continuous evaluation of cloud posture against compliance frameworks as live peripherals — not point-in-time control attestation
Audit trail and Article 33 evidence as a property of running, not as a forensic reconstruction
Full-state working memory of cloud posture, sustained between operator interactions
